name: Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers
summary: A his-and-hers pair of powerful revolvers with Vice City styling, included with the Ultimate Edition.
body: Rockstar says the styling comes from the Vercetti Estate: grips etched with palm trees, engraved detailing and a high-performance scope.
Damage, ammunition and how the pair is unlocked in play have not been published.

name: Girardi ES9
summary: Jason's pistol. The Ultimate Edition includes a personalized variant of it with detailed engraving.
body: It is named in Rockstar's description of the Personalized Weapon Variants, alongside Lucia's Klose K17. No stats have been published.
